easyPrerequisites: You have not changed the value of X this turn using Glava's ability.
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Bahamut triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting Summon: Bahamut's trigger.
Glava triggers, causing the value of X used for Gogo's ability to become 5 instead.
Resolve Gogo's ability, copying Summon: Bahamut's trigger five times.
Resolve all Summon: Bahamut triggers, dealing damage to each opponent equal to six times the total mana value of permanents you control other than Summon: Bahamut.

uses.name: Summon: Bahamut
uses.cardState: with three lore counters on it
